landing.intro: Storm's over, Keeper. Damage logged. First-shift checklist is ready.
landing.step.1: Walk to the shelter door and open it.
landing.step.2: Right-click the air tank by your bunk. Read the level.
landing.step.2.suit: Find your suit O2. Top it up at the wall tank.
landing.step.3: Open the Planetary Monitor. Find the Outside air line.
landing.step.4: Take a seal kit from the locker in Ops.
landing.step.5: Patch the crack in Hab B with your seal kit.
landing.step.6: Place your two Ovens. Check Power on the Monitor.
landing.step.7: Go out through the airlock and come back in.
landing.step.7.dust: Go out through the airlock. Use the dust-off station coming back.
landing.step.8: Open your journal from the hotbar. Your notes live here.
landing.hint.1: W A S D to walk. Right-click the door.
landing.hint.2: The tanks stand along the shelter's south wall.
landing.hint.3: The Monitor is on the north wall of Ops.
landing.hint.4: The locker is the barrel in Ops, south-west corner.
landing.hint.5: Hold the kit. Right-click the cracked plate in Hab B's west wall.
landing.hint.6: Set them in the east machine bay. Panel and battery power them.
landing.hint.7: The airlock is at the south end of the dome.
landing.hint.8: Press its number key, then right-click.
landing.skip.1: Air tanks line the shelter wall. Right-click one to read it.
landing.skip.1.suit: Suit O2: bubble icon. Refill at wall tanks.
landing.skip.2: Monitor: planet data. Journal: your notes and messages.
landing.skip.3: Seal kits patch cracked plates. The Ops locker has some.
landing.skip.3.dust: Dust off after every trip outside.
landing.log.5: Hab B sealed. Cracked plate replaced.
landing.log.6: Two Ovens on the grid. Power use is up.
